| description = If you wander around the upper ridge near the Kael zone entrance, you have a chance to spawn either a group of level 50 [[Kromrif Death Squad]] or Tanik Greskil.  In the former case you should run, but in the latter case you should hand Tanik your [[Vial of Velium Vapors]]. If your class uses pets, you can set your pet on 'Guard' and it will face the nearest spawn point (or nearest NPC, in case there is no spawn point near). Using Guard saves a lot of time. Druids and Enchanters can snag the nearby Walrus population for help. The [[Kromrif Death Squad]] mob(s) will despawn after about 2 minutes after you zone their aggro.
